claim: Sandakan Heritage Trail links restored colonial buildings and places of worship; ~1.5-2h walk
quote: restored colonial buildings like the Agnes Keith's House and places of worship including St. Michael's and All Angels Church, Sam Sing Kung (Three Saints) Temple and Goddess of Mercy Temple... about 1.5 to 2 hours to complete

claim: Trail stop order from Jamik Mosque through 100 Steps, Agnes Keith, temples to Wisma Warisan; walk early or after 3pm
quote: Jamik Mosque - Starting point... 100 Steps Staircase... Agnes Keith House... Goddess of Mercy Temple... St. Michael's and All Angels Church... Sam Sing Kung Temple... Walk early morning or after 3 PM to avoid peak heat

claim: St Michael's is one of few stone buildings in Sabah, Gothic style, construction begun 1893
quote: St Michael's is one of the very few buildings in all of Sabah to be made of stone, and with its Gothic style architecture... construction begun in 1893

claim: Sam Sing Kung built 1887, third-oldest temple in Sandakan; Goddess of Mercy (1868) is oldest
quote: Built in 1887, the temple is the third oldest temple in Sandakan, after Goddess of Mercy Temple and Tam Kung Temple... Goddess of Mercy Temple (1868)

claim: Sam Sing Kung is ~138 years old; original bronze bell donated by Fung Ming Shan, Sandakan's first Kapitan Cina (1887)
quote: For over 138 years, it has served as a vital repository of memories... original bronze bell was donated by Fung Ming Shan, Sandakan's first Kapitan Cina appointed by the British in 1887

claim: Agnes Keith House (Newlands) was home of author of 'Land Below The Wind' (1939); rebuilt 1946/47, opened as museum 26 Apr 2004
quote: occupied by famous American writer, Agnes Newton Keith, who penned 'Land Below The Wind' in 1939... rebuilt in 1946/47... opening of the house on 26th April 2004

claim: Agnes Keith House open daily 9am-5pm; non-Malaysian entry RM15
quote: Monday – Sunday, 9am – 5pm... MyKad holders: RM2.00... Others: RM15.00

claim: English Tea House sits next to Agnes Keith House for colonial-style afternoon tea and scones
quote: The English Tea House is just next door and perfect for an afternoon tea and scone after the visit

claim: Memorial Park sits on former POW camp grounds; 2,434 Allied POWs died, only 6 Australians survived, Jan-Aug 1945
quote: resulted in the deaths of 2,434 Allied prisoners of war... Only six Australians survived the wartime incarceration in Sandakan and Ranau

claim: Memorial Park free, open daily; Commemorative Pavilion opened 18 Mar 1999 with bilingual exhibition; Aug 15 service
quote: opening for visit daily, free of charge... Sandakan Commemorative Pavilion was opened on 18 March 1999 and contains a permanent exhibition

claim: More than 1,000 POWs force-marched 260km to Ranau; about half died en route
quote: more than 1,000 malnourished POWs were force-marched to Ranau, 260 kilometres from Sandakan. About half died on the way

claim: Puu Jih Shih is a hilltop Buddhist temple at Tanah Merah, largest Chinese temple in town, built 1987, ~4km west of centre
quote: located at the hilltop of Tanah Merah at Sandakan Bay... largest Chinese temple for the town... built in 1987... around 4 kilometres west of the town centre

claim: Puu Jih Shih offers commanding sunset views over Sandakan Bay and the Sulu Sea; best in late afternoon
quote: best sunset viewing spots is from hilltop Puu Jih Shih Temple, which has commanding views of Sandakan Bay and across the Sulu Sea

claim: Buli Sim Sim is a stilt water village, site of original 1879 Sandakan town, with seafood restaurants
quote: Kampung Buli Sim Sim is a water village on stilts... This is also the site of the original town of Sandakan which began in 1879

claim: Sandakan Central Market and Sim Sim offer local cuisine and grilled seafood at reasonable prices
quote: complete your travels with delicious local cuisine at the Sandakan Central Market or Sim Sim Water Village... grilled fish and other seafood delights at reasonable prices

claim: Sepilok feeding platform sessions at 10am and 3pm; non-Malaysian entry RM30, camera fee RM10; book online in peak months
quote: feeding times at the main feeding platform are at 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM... entrance fee is RM30 for adults... camera fee of RM10

claim: Orangutans are wild and free-ranging; sightings at feeds are never guaranteed, especially during fruiting season or rain
quote: they are wild and free to travel in the reserve it can never be guaranteed that any will come for the feed at all

claim: Bornean Sun Bear Conservation Centre sits in the Kabili-Sepilok Forest Reserve next to the orangutan centre
quote: nestled within the lush Kabili-Sepilok Forest Reserve in Sabah, Malaysia

claim: BSBCC is the world's only sun bear conservation centre, founded 2008, opened to public 2014
quote: Bornean Sun Bear Conservation Centre

claim: RDC canopy skywalk is 620m long, the longest in Sabah, up to 27m above the forest floor
quote: skywalk with an extensive length of 620 meters, the longest in Sabah... rises up to 27 metres above the forest floor

claim: RDC open 8am-5pm; non-resident adult RM30, child RM20; night walk RM50, 23km from Sandakan
quote: Non-resident adults pay RM30.00 per day, children (5-17 years) RM20.00... Night walks can be booked in advance for RM50 per adult... open from 8:00 am - 5:00 pm

claim: Labuk Bay proboscis monkey feeds: Platform A 9:30am & 2:30pm, Platform B 11:30am & 4:30pm; open 8am-6pm daily
quote: feeding at Platform A at 9:30am and 2:30pm... Platform B at 11:30am and 4:30pm... open Monday - Sunday : 8:00 am - 6:00 pm

claim: Labuk Bay adult ticket RM60, child (3-12) RM30, photo fee RM10
quote: 60 Malaysian ringgits for adults, 30 ringgits for children aged 3–12 years old... fee of 10 ringgits if you want to take photos

claim: Turtle Islands Park lies 40km north of Sandakan, comprising Selingan, Gulisan and Bakungan Kechil; green and hawksbill nesting
quote: Turtle Islands Park lies 40 km north of Sandakan and comprises three small islands: Selingan, Gulisan and Bakungan Kechil

claim: Turtles come ashore at Selingan nightly year-round; rangers move eggs to hatchery, hatchlings emerge after 50-60 days; overnight stay recommended
quote: turtles come ashore nightly... transfer them to the island's turtle hatchery... hatchlings emerge from the nest after 50-60 days... overnight stay is highly recommended

claim: Selingan limited to ~50 visitors per night; pre-booking essential; peak nesting July-October
quote: visitor numbers are limited to 50 per night so pre-booking is essential... peak turtle nesting season is between July and October

claim: Book Selingan as far ahead as possible; early-April tours sold out off-peak; permits issued via Crystal Quest
quote: you should book ahead as far as you can... Tours in early April were fully booked... tickets from Sabah Parks are sold through Crystal Quest

claim: Official Selingan turtle-watching overnight tour package operator
quote: Turtle Watching Tour Package | Selingan Turtle Island

claim: Gomantong is Sabah's largest edible bird's-nest cave (WWF 'best managed'); Simud Hitam black nests, ceilings to 90m; harvested Feb-Apr and Jul-Sep
quote: largest cave and the most important source of the prized Chinese edible birds' nest in Sabah... best managed edible birds' nest cave in the world... Harvesting takes place between February and April and in July to September

claim: Gomantong is ~1.5h drive from Sandakan; ~2 million bats exit at dusk; boardwalks access the caves
quote: 1½ hour overland drive from Sandakan... some 2 million bats exit the caves en masse... network of well-maintained boardwalks

claim: Kinabatangan visited as overnight lodge stay (multiple cruises) or as a day trip from Sandakan
quote: How to Do a Kinabatangan River Cruise: The Best Way To Get There

claim: Gomantong Cave and Kinabatangan cruise are commonly combined as a day trip from Sandakan
quote: Sandakan - Gomantong Cave & Kinabatangan River Cruise

claim: Lankayan is a luxury private dive island ~90 min boat from Sandakan with 16 beach and 9 over-water chalets; low season Sep-Jun, high Jul-Aug
quote: luxury private island resort located near Sandakan (90 minutes by boat)... 16 luxury beach front chalets along with 9 over-the-water luxury chalets

claim: Lankayan boat transfer runs daily in peak (Jul-Sep), 3x/week otherwise; package includes guided dives
quote: During peak season (July, August & September) the boat transfer... operates daily; at other times... only 3 times per week

claim: Sandakan's drier months are March-September; NE monsoon Oct-Feb brings heaviest east-coast rain
quote: best time to visit Sandakan is March, April, May, July, and August... drier weather, calmer seas

claim: Southwest monsoon May-Sep is drier; Northeast monsoon Oct-Feb brings heavier rain to the east coast including Sandakan/Kinabatangan
quote: Northeast Monsoon from October to February brings heavier rainfall, particularly to the east coast, which is home to wildlife hotspots like Sandakan and the Kinabatangan River

claim: General Sabah best-time guidance; avoid heaviest rains for outdoor and sea activities
quote: Best time to visit Sabah

claim: Sandakan reached by ~2h50 flight from Kuala Lumpur or ~45 min from Kota Kinabalu (Firefly)
quote: Firefly offers direct flights to Sandakan from Kota Kinabalu... quick 45-minute flight... Kuala Lumpur and Sandakan typically takes about 2 hours and 50 minutes

claim: Sepilok is ~25km from Sandakan; local bus RM4 (~45 min) or taxi/Grab ~RM50
quote: Buses from Sandakan to Sepilok... fare is 4 ringgit per person and it takes about 45 minutes... taxi to Sepilok will cost around 50 RM

claim: Official guidance on transfers between Sandakan airport/town and Sepilok
quote: How to get from Sandakan airport to Sepilok

claim: Selingan is part of Turtle Islands National Park, a sanctuary for green and hawksbill turtles
quote: Turtle Islands National Park

claim: BSBCC tickets bookable online; sits beside the orangutan centre in Sepilok
quote: Bornean Sun Bear Conservation Centre (BSBCC) Tickets [2026]

claim: Kinabatangan lodges (Nature Lodge, Sukau Rainforest Lodge) offer 2-night packages with multiple cruises and night/dawn walks
quote: Nature Lodge Kinabatangan offers 2-night experiences with four separate cruises plus night and dawn walking safaris... Sukau Rainforest Lodge

claim: Agnes Keith House is an official Sabah Museum site on Jalan Istana hill
quote: Agnes Keith House, Sandakan | Sabah Museum

claim: Heritage Trail's 100 Steps connect the lower town to the colonial hilltop with bay views
quote: Sandakan Heritage Trail | Historical Attractions in Sandakan, Sabah
